proof.text: The only ending with a loser in the spec is checkmate (`rules.win`), which needs a royal piece in check. White starts with no royal piece and can never get one: `rules.promotion` targets Q, C, A, R, B, N, none royal, and there are no drops. `rules.stalemate` is a draw, and nothing else (`forbid_immobility` restricts moves, decides nothing) ends a game against White. So no position is a White loss. White is not claimed to win.
